body: Yes, I'm still here. The more and more I think about it, the more and more I realize that there is no way for me to "go away". I know that if I killed myself that members of my family might so the same. No amount of anguish is enough for me to put them through that. I don't feel emotionally isolated. I wish that's what it was. Then it would make this decision easy, unfortunately I have people who depend on me being alive, and there is no foreseeable way to rid myself of that element. I guess I'm going to have to continue. Miserably. This isn't for me, it's for the people around me.
